rationale: The Latin anchor *putrefacere* means "to cause to rot/putrefy," indicating a concrete physical sense of decomposition or corruption of matter. None of the four candidates capture this literal biological/physical sense: corrupt.v.01 is moral corruption, bribe.v.01 is bribery, defile.v.01 is reputational, and corrupt.v.04 refers to alteration of data/text. The physical "to rot, to putrefy" sense has no adequate WordNet analog among the candidates.
